note: T-276: border factors for the joint commute gravity (sim/src/bin/joint_gravity.rs) between zones of two packs. A pair of regions held by one pack takes that pack's own factor (its gravity block's border_factor); other pairs within a country (the line between two packs) take admin1_default, else pack_line_default (0.4, Japan's fit: the default for a country with no fit of its own, Anita 2026-10-16, T-584; before it, no factor, T-181); pairs across a national border take national["A|B"] (alphabetical ISO 3166 codes) or national_default. US 0.23: the US packs' fit on LODES (T-162, T-198). JP 0.4: between Japanese packs, fitted so the commuters between packs match the 2020 census's between the same prefectures less telework (T-463; at 1 the model sent 1.9 times the census); prefecture lines inside a pack take no factor (T-420). US-Canada 0.05: judgement, few thousand commute between Windsor and Detroit where a plain gravity would send several times more; fit it on census flows when a zone pair across the border is built.
